counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: A mutable registry flag marks the new implementation default after tests pass. The field instead grants only a scoped canary lease because the runtime replay, evaluator independence, and default-route obligations remain unresolved.

normative_rule: Keep the field contract fixed while qualifying an exact candidate and its dependencies. Preserve historical regressions, incidents, state-migration duties, authority ceilings, expiry, and an executable fallback; unknown or failed obligations block default routing.
